item.title: [Bug] Copilot loses/truncates earlier chat context and incorrectly claims no prior work was done in the same session
item.body:
[copilot_all_prompts_2026-03-01T17-49-43.chatreplay.json.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25664384/copilot_all_prompts_2026-03-01T17-49-43.chatreplay.json.zip)
[GitHub Copilot Chat_2026-03-01T17-49-43.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25664383/GitHub.Copilot.Chat_2026-03-01T17-49-43.zip)

## Bug Report

### Summary
GitHub Copilot (Chat) denied that any implementation had taken place in the **current, active chat session**, while the user could visually confirm the implementation was present in the same chat log. Copilot falsely stated "there was no implementation" and "this session only contained X, Y, Z messages" — all of which was incorrect.

from the debug-chat-log it seems the memory fails for everything before "promptId": "6b5ecca1-prompt".

[GitHub Copilot Chat_2026-03-01T17-49-43.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25664018/GitHub.Copilot.Chat_2026-03-01T17-49-43.zip)

### Environment
- **Date:** 2026-03-01
- **Editor:** Visual Studio Code
- **GitHub Copilot model:** Claude Sonnet 4.6
- **OS:** Windows 11
- **Repository:** Private GitHub repository (`MartinM8266/BaustellenOrdner_maintenance`)

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Open a long or ongoing chat session in GitHub Copilot Chat (VS Code).
2. Perform one or more implementation tasks (code generation, file edits, etc.) earlier in the session.
3. Later in the **same session**, ask Copilot to recap or reference what was done.
4. Copilot responds as if the earlier messages/implementation do not exist.

### Observed Behavior
Copilot stated:
> "Looking back at this session, there was no implementation — the full history here is: …"

This was factually incorrect. The user could clearly see the implementation in the chat log.

When challenged, Copilot acknowledged:
> "I can only see the portion of the conversation that has been passed to me as context — if the session was long, earlier parts may have been truncated or not included in my context window."

### Expected Behavior
Copilot should either:
- Correctly reference all messages within the active session, **or**
- Clearly communicate upfront that only a limited context window is available and that earlier messages may not be visible — rather than confidently asserting they do not exist.

### Impact
- Causes user confusion and loss of trust in the tool.
- User may incorrectly believe their work was not saved or performed.
- Leads to unnecessary re-work and debugging effort.

### Additional Notes
The incorrect denial was stated with high confidence, which is more misleading than a simple "I don't know." The model should prefer expressing uncertainty over making false confident claims about the state of the session.

---
*Bug raised via GitHub Copilot itself, on behalf of user `MartinM8266`.*
